title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager
description:
About Dacxi Chain

Dacxi Chain is building the critical infrastructure for the future of global capital formation. As the world's first tokenized crowdfunding infrastructure, we're creating the foundational layer that enables entrepreneurs to connect with everyday investors worldwide through blockchain technology. By tokenizing company shares on our infrastructure, we're eliminating traditional barriers like geographical borders and limited liquidity - making capital raising seamless for businesses and investment opportunities accessible to everyone, everywhere. We're not just creating a platform; we're architecting the essential infrastructure that will power the next generation of crowdfunding - transparent, scalable, and globally accessible.

Job Description: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager

We are searching for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager to lead our most critical initiatives. This advanced hybrid role combines the governance of a PMO, the hands-on coordination of a Delivery Manager, and the technical depth of a Project Manager. You will also be entrusted with key Product Owner responsibilities, acting as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure projects are not only delivered on time and within budget but also align with our strategic product vision and maintain the highest quality standards.

Important: This role is only open to candidates based in Brazil , and requires fluent Portuguese and fluent English .

This is a fully remote position, working with teams across Brazil, the UK, and New Zealand.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Governance & Technical PMO:

  • Develop, refine, and enforce technical project management methodologies and best practices across the organization.
  • Manage and maintain a comprehensive RAID log, proactively identifying and mitigating potential roadblocks.
  • Maintain a decision log to document and track key project decisions, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Oversee an action log, holding all team members and stakeholders accountable for their commitments.
  • Implement "Planned vs. Actual" reporting to track project performance against initial baselines, highlighting deviations in scope, schedule, and budget.

Delivery & Release Management:

  • Serve as the central point of contact for project coordination, facilitating communication and collaboration between product, development, QA, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams across different time zones.
  • Partner with QA to ensure testing is integrated seamlessly into the project lifecycle, from early-stage validation to final quality assurance.
  • Coordinate with GTM teams to align on release schedules and ensure a smooth, well-prepared launch of new products or features.
  • Orchestrate and manage the end-to-end release process, ensuring all dependencies are met and risks are mitigated.
  • Hold product and engineering teams accountable for their commitments, ensuring deliverables are met on time and to the required standard.

Project & Product Ownership:

  • Lead the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning to execution and post-mortem analysis.
  • Act as the Product Owner for specific initiatives, ensuring the development team's work aligns with the overall product roadmap.
  • Translate business and user needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
  • Proactively identify and address potential pitfalls, technical debt, and risks to ensure the project stays on track.
  • Provide high-quality, data-driven reporting to leadership and stakeholders, offering transparent insights into project status and performance.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a technical project management role, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated experience with PMO functions, including process standardization, governance, and portfolio management.
  • Must be currently based in Brazil and fluent in both written and verbal Portuguese and English.
  • Expertise in managing project documentation, specifically RAID logs, decision logs, and action logs.
  • A track record of successfully holding cross-functional teams accountable for their deliverables.
  • Experience performing Product Owner duties, such as managing a product backlog and defining user stories.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of coordinating development, QA, and GTM teams across global locations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights from metrics like "planned vs. actual".
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or similar) are highly desirable.

Preferred Skills:

  • Innovative Mindset: A forward-thinking approach, staying ahead of industry and technology trends.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven decision-making approach.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to manage expectations and keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned.
  • Execution & Ownership: Strong sense of ownership, with a track record of driving complex projects to completion on time and to quality.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adjusting plans as priorities evolve.

This role is for a proactive leader who is passionate about both the big picture and the details. If you're ready to define processes, drive technical delivery, hold teams accountable, and help shape our product vision, we want to hear from you.

Interested?

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! Join us in revolutionizing the global funding landscape at Dacxi Chain.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur
description:
We’re Hiring!

Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.

Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.

We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION : Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

LOCATION : São Paulo / Brazil

JOB TYPE : Permanent

ROLE SENIORITY : Managerial

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Coordinates production with tollers, ensuring alignment with the sales plan, efficient execution, and resolution of conflicts and delays. Plans and manages the availability of materials and active ingredients (AI), executing MRP calculations, purchasing, and logistics coordination with suppliers. Monitors inventory levels, intercompany transfers, and toller performance, supporting continuous improvement in collaboration with supply chain and procurement teams.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Owns toller coordination, ensuring production scheduling aligns with sales plan and demand priorities while maintaining adherence to frozen periods and committed production slots
  • Coordinates daily/weekly production plans with tollers, ensuring smooth execution by tracking output, resolving scheduling conflicts, and mitigating production delays. Works closely with the senior supply and planning specialist to align production priorities.
  • Monitors production execution, proactively identifying and addressing issues related to toller capacity, material shortages, or unexpected disruptions. Escalates unresolved risks to supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Owns material planning, ensures material availability of AI, co-formulants, and packaging readiness for planned production runs. Collaborates with suppliers and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Tracks and reports toller inventory levels, working with the Inventory Manager to identify potential shortages, excess stock, or discrepancies at toller sites.
  • Feeds production output data into ERP systems, ensuring visibility of completed batches and enabling accurate intercompany transfer orders, stock movements, and replenishment planning.
  • Collaborates with Logistics & Distribution, ensuring timely execution of intercompany transfers for finished goods and AI. Aligns outbound logistics, transportation planning, and carrier coordination to facilitate seamless material movement.
  • Provides input on toller performance, tracking adherence to schedules, production efficiency, and issue resolution. Supports continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Runs MRP calculations daily/weekly, ensuring accurate material replenishment by validating planning parameters such as lead times, order quantities, and safety stock. Drives improvement in planning accuracy by refining MRP parameters based on supply performance.
  • Updates MRP with supplier feedback, incorporating changes in lead times, production constraints, and delivery schedules to ensure material availability. Works closely with suppliers to proactively adjust for potential delays and optimize material flow.
  • Manages procurement execution, creating and tracking purchase orders for direct materials and AI.
  • Communicates material requirements to suppliers, validating availability against forecasts and ensuring timely deliveries.
  • Coordinates material and AI call-offs, ensuring timely deliveries from suppliers while optimizing logistics flows in collaboration with Distribution & Logistics. Monitors transportation lead times and ensure alignment with toller production schedules.
  • Acts as secondary support as senior supply and planning specialist in Conosur and Brazil according to the business needs.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
  • APICS certification strongly recommended;
  • Post-graduation is desired;
  • Project Management skills;
  • 3+ years cumulative experience in Supply Chain Planning & Tollers; Inventory Management;
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Teamwork, Drives Results, Analytics, Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving;
  • Assertive Communication, Leadership and influencing skills required;
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems;
  • Required fluent Spanish and English;
  • Availability for travel (15%)

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

  • Levantamento de Requisitos: Colaborar com diferentes áreas e stakeholders (internos e externos) para entender as necessidades de negócio, mapeando requisitos funcionais e técnicos.

  • Documentação: Manter a documentação clara e organizada sobre os processos e soluções implementadas.

  • Experiência em SQL, Python e outras ferramentas de análise de dados e de visualização de dados como Power BI, por exemplo.

  • Foco no Cliente: Entendimento das necessidades dos clientes e comprometimento em entregar soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Visão holística: de processos, do cliente e da Neoway para que possa atuar de forma crítica e propositiva/proativa;

#Diferencial:

title: Especialista de Políticas de Crédito
description:
Sobre o BS2

Somos um banco 100% digital e focado em empresas, com atendimento humanizado e soluções sob medida para cada cliente - afinal, nenhum negócio é igual ao outro. Essa lógica também se aplica à nossa cultura: temos um DNA inovador que instiga todo o nosso time a se reinventar constantemente. Por aqui, nossos colaboradores (os bessers) podem contar com um ambiente que impulsiona o crescimento da carreira e traz a oportunidade de lidar com os desafios do mercado financeiro com quem mais entende do assunto.

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Políticas de Crédito para atuar de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento, implantação e monitoramento de políticas voltadas ao segmento Varejo PJ.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Estatística avançada e modelagem matemática.

Experiência com tecnologia e metodologias ágeis.

Vivência com motores de decisão e integração de políticas em sistemas.

️ Vale refeição no valor de R$1.173,04 ao mês;

title: Sr Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;
  • Elaborar e conduzir refinamentos técnicos de demandas trazidas pelo time de produtos;
  • Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js + NestJS;
  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;
  • Experiência com Design de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com Testes Unitários (jUnit 5) e Testes Contrato (Pact);
  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;
  • Experiência com em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.

Diferencias:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos/front-end com React Native e React;
  • Experiência com Javascript/Typescript;
  • Experiencia com Next.js, React Hooks, Styled Components, Axios;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Microfrontend (MFE)

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Arquiteto de Domínio Redes
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Arquiteto de domínio Redes , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o projeto, a documentação e a evolução de arquiteturas de rede corporativas, industriais e de missão crítica para operações globais, subterrâneas, remotas, móveis/IoT e em nuvem/híbridas.
  • Especifique padrões, diagramas de alta e baixa complexidade (visão lógica, física, topologia, VLAN, roteamento, SDN), considerando redundância, disponibilidade, desempenho e resiliência.
  • Avaliar, selecionar e supervisionar a implantação de tecnologias emergentes: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, 5G privado, redes mesh, VPNs, segmentação de redes OT/TI em um ambiente de mineração.
  • Defina e garanta a conformidade com os padrões globais de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), políticas de criptografia, controle de acesso, mitigação de vulnerabilidades e resposta a incidentes.
  • Liderar projetos de integração de rede entre Brasil, Canadá, áreas industriais/minas, escritórios, plantas e data centers, possibilitando alta conectividade, performance e segurança.
  • Orquestrar processos de atualização tecnológica, substituição de equipamentos, automação de configuração e monitoramento de rede, incluindo SRE, Service Mesh.
  • Crie e mantenha documentação detalhada: diagramas, fluxos, planos de contingência, manuais, políticas de uso, governança e modelos técnicos.
  • Interface direta com equipes de Engenharia, Operações, Segurança, DevOps, Automação Industrial, equipes globais de arquitetura e fornecedores estratégicos.
  • Monitorar, otimizar e evoluir a infraestrutura de comunicação, visando a máxima eficiência, suporte a IoT, análise industrial, operação autônoma de mina e compliance.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Domínio dos principais protocolos, arquiteturas e padrões: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, Convergência OT/IT.
  • Experiência real com soluções industriais Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens, plataformas de rede em nuvem (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Interface prática com ambientes complexos: subterrâneo/mineração, redes industriais, ambientes industriais 4.0, integração em nuvem, alta disponibilidade, recuperação de desastres.
  • Experiência em automação de redes (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), monitoramento avançado (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excelência em documentação, desenho técnico, suporte à governança, integração multiplataforma e atuação internacional com equipes remotas.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
  • Experiência em projetos greenfield/brownfield, integração de redes industriais/IoT, edge/mesh/satélite, digitalização de minas.
  • Experiência com redes subterrâneas, soluções sem fio específicas para mineração, ambientes industriais de OT/TI, SRE/observabilidade em escala global.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em diferentes fusos horários, ambientes multi-site e equipes multiculturais.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação global.

Formação:

  • Bacharel em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação, Computação, Sistemas Industriais ou áreas afins

Graduação em Sistemas ou áreas afins.

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche

  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: New Merchant Growth Strategy
description:
About Us:

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'II Do:

  • Overall responsible for new merchant growth strategy.
  • Collaborate closely with frontline teams and merchants to collect merchant and management requirements, and distill them into overall strategies, including operational workflows and product functionalities.
  • Collaborate with relevant business teams to develop comprehensive product operation plans.
  • Monitor merchant usage of products in daily operations, collaborate with multiple teams to drive continuous iteration of product features, conduct product function training and promotion, and ensure the achievement of business objectives for product effectiveness.

What We Need From You:

  • Experience in project management and strategy. Familiar with strategy development, product operations, and common corporate methodologies.
  • Familiar with the merchant-side operations of e-commerce platforms. Priority will be given to those with experience in the food delivery industry.
  • Possesses excellent solution planning capabilities and has a basic understanding of B-end operational work. Demonstrates strong logical thinking skills.
  • Possesses excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills, achieving win-win results by integrating resources and cooperating with different business departments.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

  • Join a startup-like business. Opportunity to participate in the design of key business processes and products.
  • Grow alongside rapidly expanding businesses.
  • Work with members from 25 countries and experience a diverse work environment.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.

Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.

Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.

Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

description:

Essa função conecta as áreas de Criação, Estratégia e Produção, garantindo que cada projeto — seja uma ativação de marca, estande, evento ou experiência imersiva — seja executado com excelência técnica, coerência estética e impacto visual.

Domínio de SketchUp e noções de AutoCAD e/ou outros softwares 3D;

Experiência com cenografia, ativações de marca e materiais efêmeros;

Boa comunicação e autonomia técnica;

Conhecimento em Trade Marketing e Brand Experience;

Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horários;

Experiência prévia em agência de marketing, arquitetura promocional ou branding.

Diferenciais:

Repertório visual atualizado e sensibilidade estética;

Vivência em projetos de grande porte e ambientações imersivas.

title: Analista de Vendas Jr. - Manaus
description:
A DAIKIN é uma empresa multinacional japonesa com sede em Osaka, Japão, e é a maior fabricante de condicionadores de ar do mundo.

No Brasil há 12 anos, a DAIKIN BRASIL possui uma estrutura para atender Distribuidores e Usuários com equipes em São Paulo (SP), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Recife (PE) e Porto Alegre (RS). Na cidade de Manaus (AM), está localizada a unidade de produção com 350 funcionários, totalizando um quadro de 580 pessoas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e abordar novos clientes (comerciais, residenciais e instaladoras), comunicando de forma clara as vantagens técnicas dos produtos Daikin.
  • Prestar suporte comercial e administrativo à carteira de clientes B2B, varejo e instaladoras na região de Manaus e Norte, incluindo acompanhamento de pedidos e atendimento a demandas internas e externas.
  • Colaborar na resolução de questões técnicas e comerciais junto a instaladores, engenheiros e especificadores, garantindo um atendimento eficiente e orientado a detalhes.
  • Analisar o mercado e identificar oportunidades comerciais, apoiando o desenvolvimento de estratégias com base em dados, tendências e ações da concorrência, além de participar de iniciativas de trade marketing e ações de sell-out em campo.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com empresas instaladoras, alinhando-se aos padrões da Daikin e adotando uma abordagem consultiva focada no público técnico.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior em Marketing, Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia no setor comercial/vendas;
  • Habilidade com Pacote Office (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word) especialmente para relatórios e controle de vendas;
  • Noções das ISOs 9001, 14001 e 45001;
  • CNH-B e disponibilidade para trabalho em campo quando necessário;
  • Desejável conhecimento de ERP Protheus.

title: Designer
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Designer to design and produce various online and offline promotional materials for our mobile phone brand. As the Designer, you will work closely with the marketing, branding, and sale teams to ensure brand consistency and create compelling visual assets that support product promotion and enhance brand awareness.Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Designer to design and produce various online and offline promotional materials for our mobile phone brand. As the Designer, you will work closely with the marketing, branding, and sale teams to ensure brand consistency and create compelling visual assets that support product promotion and enhance brand awareness.

Key Responsibilities:

Advertising and Promotional Materials Design:

  • Design and create a wide range of promotional materials, including but not limited to online ads (e.g., social media ads, web banners, Google Ads), offline promotional items (e.g., posters, banners, flyers), and multimedia presentations (e.g., videos, GIFs).
  • Ensure that all promotional materials align with the brand’s visual identity and effectively convey product information and brand values.

Digital Marketing Assets Design:

  • Create and localize visually engaging assets for digital marketing campaigns across social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, etc.), including posts, ads, cover images, and more.
  • Design visual content for email marketing campaigns, display ads, and in-app promotions to ensure cohesive branding across all digital marketing efforts.

Event and Exhibition Design:

  • Design visuals for offline events, exhibitions, and product launch events, including booth designs, posters, brochures, and signage, ensuring impactful brand presence.
  • Create visual concepts tailored to specific event themes while maintaining brand consistency and attractiveness.

Brand Consistency and Optimization:

  • Ensure that all marketing materials adhere to brand guidelines and maintain consistent visual style across all channels.
  • Continuously improve existing designs to enhance ad performance and provide an engaging visual experience for customers.

Cross-Team Collaboration:

  • Collaborate closely with marketing, product, and sales teams to understand business needs and provide design support for marketing campaigns.
  • Communicate with external ad agencies and printing vendors to ensure high-quality outputs and optimal printing results for promotional materials.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Visual Design, Graphic Design, Advertising Design, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience in design, preferably in consumer electronics (mobile phone industry experience is a plus).
  • Proficiency in design software (Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.), with video editing skills (Premiere, After Effects) being a plus.
  • Familiarity with the design requirements of digital and social media advertising, with a portfolio of successful digital marketing campaigns preferred
  • Strong creative abilities, capable of producing high-impact promotional designs based on brand positioning and market needs.
  • Excellent time management skills, able to handle multiple design projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand marketing needs and translate them into effective design solutions

title: Especialista em Controladoria
description:
A Oswaldo Cruz Química é uma das maiores empresas do setor químico da América Latina. Pertencente ao Grupo OCQ, foi criada em 1984 e desde então desenvolveu e produziu uma infinidade de resinas e demais matérias-primas que atendem aos mais importantes setores da economia, como construção civil, tintas, plásticos, papéis, setor têxtil, educação, higiene & beleza, madeira, setor agrícola, entre outros.

Na Oswaldo Cruz Química, nos desafiamos constantemente a buscar o novo, compartilhamos boas práticas e identificamos oportunidades para transformar o nosso dia a dia e de nossos clientes. Para isto, formamos um time repleto de pessoas criativas, colaborativas, com senso de dono e que colocam paixão em tudo o que fazem!

No Grupo OCQ valorizamos pessoas colaborativas, que possuem paixão por entregar, que cuidam dos relacionamentos, criativas e principalmente, com atitude de dono.

Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe. Valorizamos cada indivíduo, independentemente de sua etnia, cor, raça, religião, origem, idade, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra condição. Todas as nossas vagas estão acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência.

Se identificou com os nossos valores? Junte-se a nós! =)

Reponsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e revisar demonstrações financeiras conforme normas locais (CPC/IFRS) e exigências da CVM;
  • Realizar consolidação de demonstrações contábeis de múltiplas empresas do grupo;
  • Apoiar e coordenar os processos de auditoria externa e relacionamento com auditores independentes (Big 4);
  • Preparar e revisar Formulário de Referência, ITR, DFP e demais obrigações periódicas junto à CVM;
  • Garantir a conformidade das informações contábeis e financeiras divulgadas ao mercado;
  • Acompanhar atualizações regulatórias e apoiar na implementação de novas exigências da CVM e B3;
  • Participar do fechamento contábil e reportes gerenciais, assegurando qualidade e aderência às normas;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos, controles internos e automatização de rotinas contábeis.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou Administração;
  • Experiência prévia em auditoria externa (Big 4) e controladoria corporativa;
  • Conhecimento avançado em CPC/IFRS e normas da CVM;
  • Vivência com elaboração de Formulário de Referência, ITR e DFP;
  • Experiência em consolidação de demonstrações financeiras (CPC 36) e combinação de demonstrações financeiras (CPC 44);
  • Será um diferencial se tiver conhecimentos de conversão de demonstrações financeiras (CPC 02);
  • Excel avançado e desejável conhecimento em ERP (JDE – Oracle ou similares); e
  • Boa comunicação, organização, espírito de dono, saber atuar em estruturas organizacionais de alta complexidade (Grupo familiar) e visão crítica.

Salário a combinar.

Benefícios:

title: Travel and Events Associate - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

About the Role

Join us as a Travel and Events Associate and become the linchpin of our Client Solutions team's success. In this dynamic role, you'll blend the art of travel coordination with the science of data analysis, ensuring our executives are always in the right place at the right time. Your keen eye for detail will transform raw data into strategic insights, fueling our lead generation and sales efforts. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and get excited about the intersection of global business, events, and analytics, this position offers a unique opportunity to make your mark in the tech industry's vibrant landscape.

What will I do?

Data Entry Dynamo : Perform data entry for various stages of data collection for events, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Event Scout : Source relevant and important events for executives to attend, contributing to our networking strategy.

Report Compiler : Enter data for the area's reports, providing crucial information for decision-making.

Data Detective : Conduct data analysis for reports, uncovering trends and insights to drive our business forward.

Required skills and qualifications:

Commercial Veteran : 2+ years of experience in commercial teams, navigating the complexities of business operations.

Data Wizard : Strong data analysis experience, able to transform numbers into actionable insights.

Language Luminary : Advanced level of English for clear communication in our global environment.

Bonus Skill : Experience in commercial support, enhancing your ability to contribute to team goals.

Benefits:

  • Flexibility : Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.
  • Tailored Compensation : Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.
  • Tech-Driven Tools : Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
  • Autonomous Workflow : Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
  • Well-being : Enjoy paid parental leave, vacations, and national holidays for rest and rejuvenation.
  • Diversity & Inclusion : Thrive in our innovative and multicultural work environment.
  • Development : Access mentorship, promotions, and diverse growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.

More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA).

Quais as responsabilidades?

Coordenar a equipe de operadores, assegurando que todas as metas de desempenho das áreas sejam alcançadas, realizando o acompanhamento diário das operações e implementando melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas afins;

Experiência em operações CTT e Torre de Manutenção;

Sólida vivência com indicadores de performance das operações e equipamentos;

Desejável conhecimento em sistemas como Simplefarm, Gatec, Solinftec, Logtrac;

Gestão de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript) to join our growing engineering team. You will work on high-impact projects, contributing to front-end and back-end solutions that demand scalability, maintainability, and architectural elegance.

This is not just about coding – we want someone who can design abstract solutions, implement complex features, and influence technical decisions that shape our platform for years to come.

  • Build and maintain back-end services with NestJS.

  • Review code, mentor peers, and promote best practices in software engineering.
  • Take ownership of complex features from concept to production.

Qualifications

  • ⁠Mandatory: Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Mandatory: Proven experience with NestJS.
  • Mandatory: Experience in at least two front-end frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, Vue.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture patterns (DI, modularization, micro frontends, event-driven, etc.).
  • Experience building and maintaining complex, scalable systems.
  • Strong grasp of CSS, HTML5, responsive design, and UI performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate in remote-first teams.
  • A mindset for clean code, testing, and maintainability.

Nice to Have

  • ⁠Experience with microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • ⁠Knowledge of design systems and component-driven development.
  • Experience with AI-powered applications.

description:
Zootecnista - Confinamento de Bovinos de Corte

Título da Vaga: Zootecnista - Gestão de Confinamento de Engorda

Local de Trabalho: Monte Alegre de Minas/MG

Modalidade: Presencial | Tempo Integral

A Empresa:

A Green Farming Fazendas Renováveis é uma empresa brasileira especializada na produção de carne de alta qualidade, originária do cruzamento industrial de raças taurinas e zebuínas. Fundada com o objetivo de produzir carne de alto padrão na região do cerrado brasileiro, a empresa tem sede em Monte Alegre de Minas, MG.

Missão do Cargo:

O Zootecnista será o responsável técnico e operacional pela gestão completa do setor de confinamento, garantindo a máxima eficiência produtiva, o bem-estar animal e a qualidade da carne, por meio de um manejo nutricional, sanitário e de gestão de rebanho de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  1. Nutrição e Formulação de Dietas:
  • Formular e ajustar dietas de alto desempenho para as diferentes categorias de bovinos em engorda, visando o melhor custo-benefício e maximização do GPD (Ganho de Peso Diário).
  • Supervisionar e garantir o controle de qualidade e a correta mistura (homogeneidade) da ração na fábrica e nos vagões forrageiros.
  • Realizar a Leitura de Cocho (Escore de Cocho) diária, tomando decisões assertivas sobre o ajuste da quantidade e do tipo de dieta fornecida.
  • Gerenciar o estoque e a qualidade dos insumos (volumosos, concentrados, núcleos, aditivos).
  1. Manejo Zootécnico e Sanitário:
  • Planejar e executar o protocolo de chegada, adaptação e embarque dos animais.
  • Monitorar diariamente o estado de saúde e o bem-estar dos animais, identificando precocemente problemas sanitários e orientando o manejo do curral-hospital (em parceria com Médico Veterinário, se houver).
  • Gerenciar a formação e a lotação dos lotes de animais (separação por peso, sexo, escore corporal e/ou raça).
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de bem-estar animal e biosseguridade.
  1. Gestão de Pessoas e Infraestrutura:
  • Coordenar, treinar e supervisionar a equipe de trato e manejo do confinamento.
  • Garantir a manutenção e a funcionalidade das instalações (currais, cochos, bebedouros, fábrica de ração, pátio de compostagem).
  • Controlar o uso e a manutenção dos maquinários e equipamentos utilizados no manejo da alimentação.
  1. ﻿ Análise de Dados e Resultados:
  • Coletar, registrar e analisar dados de desempenho (Peso de Entrada/Saída, GPD, Conversão Alimentar, Rendimento de Carcaça).
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais de acompanhamento produtivo e financeiro para a diretoria.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão e softwares específicos para otimizar os processos do confinamento.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Zootecnia (Obrigatório).
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência comprovada em Confinamento de Bovinos de Corte (foco em nutrição, manejo de cocho e gestão de equipes).
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
  • Domínio em formulação de dietas para bovinos de corte.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão agropecuária e planilhas eletrônicas avançadas (Excel).
  • Conhecimento sobre qualidade de grãos e volumosos.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais:
  • Liderança e Habilidade para gestão e treinamento de equipes.
  • Proatividade, senso de urgência e capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas em ambiente de alta pressão.
  • Comprometimento com resultados, bem-estar animal e sustentabilidade.
Diferenciais:
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Nutrição de Ruminantes ou Produção de Bovinos de Corte.
  • Experiência com sistemas de recria intensiva.
Oferecemos:
  • Salário competitivo (a ser negociado)
  • Moradia na fazenda
  • Fazenda próxima da cidade de Monte Alegre de Minas/MG
  • Benefícios adicionais

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

As the Finance Analyst, you will support the Brazil Subsidiary/Other Latam Distributor market and provide key management information. You will coordinate with the Central Finance team on a regular basis for Financial Planning and Analysis and Financial Controller support. You will play a pivot role in supporting the Lead, with all finance related matters in the Region.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare budget & forecasts and present the monthly analysis against actuals explaining the variation reasons for revenue, cost and fixed cost.

  • Work alongside internal business teams and functions to assist with all facets of strategy development, business planning and financial analysis.
  • Produce pricing analysis and costings when required for new/existing models or price changes for bikes and non-bikes
  • Build and maintain robust financial models and scenarios analyses for strategic decision support
  • Support manufacturing cost analysis
  • Validation of pricing walk as per SBP vs Actual cost /Margins for Bikes
  • Keep track of inventory ageing (Bikes and Non Bikes) and work on actions to clear inventory, financials provisioning.
  • Ensure all stock reconciliations are matched with SAP and physical warehouse stock.
  • Update and maintain weekly cash flow forecast to reflect the latest business position.
  • Track business performance against KPIs.
  • Review of Trial Balance on monthly basis and ensuring check of long aged items , control accounts and expenses
  • Ensure proper governance of processes and support Internal Control/ Compliance framework.
  • Provide ad hoc support to Finance Lead when required.

Education/ Experience:

  • Partly qualified Chartered Accountant /MBA
  • 5+ years relevant experience in a relevant role
  • Good Excel/ Google Sheets knowledge, Power BI
  • Fluent in English Language
  • Reporting of monthly Financial Accounts
  • Excellent Presentation skills
  • Excellent Communication skills
  • Fluent in English Language
  • Knowledge of SAP system
  • Knowledge of Local Taxes; Direct/ Indirect Tax knowledge
  • You will have 4 Wheeler/ 2 wheeler company experience

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling .

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

*Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

A Acquatrat é uma empresa especializada em tratamento e reuso de água, com foco em soluções industriais e de saneamento. Acquatrat is a Brazilian company specialized in water treatment and reuse, focused on industrial and sanitation solutions. We operate in the design, implementation, and management of water and wastewater treatment plants and assets, promoting sustainable and efficient water use. We are seeking a Business Development Manager to lead Acquatrat’s commercial development across Northeastern Brazil, focusing on prospecting and managing new business opportunities with water-intensive industries such as textile, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, oil & gas, steel, aquaculture, irrigation, agribusiness, and food industries.

  • Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia.
